_readme: Anything not listed here gets its title from the filename itself.
Rename a certificate file and the title updates automatically — you only
need an entry here when the filename cannot be the display title.
Fields: title, issuer, year, verify (credential URL), course (exact course URL).
Coursera items with no 'course' fall back to an official Coursera search
for the exact title, so the link can never point at the wrong course.
